Home / About

An index built in the open.

Better Ibaan is a community-maintained directory of local-government transparency portals across the Philippines. It is a way to find public information and the people building it, not an official page of any municipality.

What this is

This site keeps one readable register of Better LGU portals, independent, publicly accessible sites that make local budgets, projects and other civic information easier to find. The register is kept in the open in a public GitHub repository, where anyone can check an entry or propose a correction.

The name comes from Ibaan, Batangas: one of the listed portals is Better Ibaan. It is not the portal itself, and it does not speak for the municipality or for any listed LGU.

Working rules

  1. Source before story

    Every portal, region and status here comes from a public register. Nothing is filled in from guesswork.

  2. A date on every claim

    The dataset records when it was checked, so a stale listing looks stale instead of current.

  3. Credit where it is due

    Photographs carry their authors and licences in the sources page. The old map is a historical record, not our artwork.

  4. Open to correction

    Found a dead link or a wrong status? The upstream register accepts a public issue or pull request.

The ledger today

The current register records 174 LGUs across the Philippines. Of those, 74 are active, 0 are in progress and 0 are open for adoption. This snapshot was checked on Nov 19, 2026.
